headline: Iran Strikes U.S. Bases in Gulf; America Hits Over 80 Iranian Targets
subheadline: U.S. forces struck more than 80 Iranian sites, including missile bases, after Iranian missiles hit Kuwait and Bahrain installations in the Persian Gulf
lede: Iran launched missile attacks on U.S. bases in Kuwait and Bahrain, prompting American strikes on over 80 Iranian targets including bases and missile sites, with explosions reported in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar and Iranian missiles also striking near Erbil and Kirkuk in northern Iraq. The exchanges resulted in one firefighter killed at Iranshahr Airport in southeastern Iran and eight Iranian military personnel reported killed in attacks on Bandar Abbas and Bushehr, while Ukrainian drone operations destroyed Russian naval tankers in the Black Sea and hit an airbase in Danilovgrad. Russian forces conducted coordinated drone and missile attacks on Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro and Odesa, killing three in Kyiv and at least five in Kharkiv and Dnipro, and wounding dozens across multiple cities. At the NATO summit in Ankara, Ukrainian President Zelenskyy met Polish President Nawrocki to discuss the Russian threat, Bulgaria said its military aid to Ukraine is exhausted but will accept equipment for repair, and the European Commission confirmed Ukraine has met all EU accession conditions and is ready to open the remaining five negotiation clusters.

sections.title: Ukraine Faces Russian Missile and Drone Barrage
sections.body: A Russian drone attack on Kyiv killed three people and injured thirteen others, including a child evacuated by emergency responders. Ukrainian drone operations destroyed Russian naval tankers in the Black Sea and struck logistics hubs, including an airbase in Danilovgrad, while Russian missile strikes hit residential buildings in Kharkiv and Dnipro, killing at least five and wounding dozens across multiple cities. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy met Polish President Nawrocki at the NATO summit in Ankara to discuss the shared threat from Russia and the need for continued dialogue. Bulgaria's Prime Minister said the country has exhausted its military aid capacity to Ukraine but will accept equipment for repair and restoration, and the European Commission confirmed Ukraine has fulfilled all conditions for EU accession negotiations and is ready to open the remaining five clusters.

sections.title: Iran-U.S. Missile Exchange Escalates Gulf Conflict
sections.body: Iran launched missile attacks on U.S. bases in Kuwait and Bahrain, targeting American installations in the Persian Gulf. In response, the U.S. conducted strikes on more than 80 Iranian targets, including military bases and missile sites, following Iranian attacks on ships. Explosions were reported in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar after the Iranian missile strikes, and Iranian missiles also hit near Erbil and Kirkuk in northern Iraq. One firefighter was killed responding to explosions at Iranshahr Airport in southeastern Iran, and eight Iranian military personnel were killed in attacks on Bandar Abbas and Bushehr according to Israeli military sources.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Iran-U.S. exchange has escalated into direct military engagement with both sides striking over 80 targets and civilian infrastructure, raising humanitarian concerns and the risk of broader regional involvement. In Ukraine, Russian drone and missile barrages on cities coincide with Ukrainian strikes on Russian naval assets and logistics, while NATO talks confirm Ukraine's EU accession readiness and underscore ongoing allied support needs.
